import os
from pathlib import Path
import sys

parent = Path(os.environ['CODEXBAR_TEST_SCRATCH_PARENT'])
workspace = Path(os.environ['CODEXBAR_TEST_WORKSPACE_ROOT'])
assert workspace == Path.cwd().resolve() and workspace in parent.parents
bin_dir = parent / 'serial-tools'
bin_dir.mkdir()
adapter = bin_dir / 'swift'
adapter.write_text('''#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
subcommand="$1"
shift
case "$subcommand" in
  test|build) exec /usr/bin/swift "$subcommand" --jobs 1 "$@" ;;
  *) exec /usr/bin/swift "$subcommand" "$@" ;;
esac
''')
adapter.chmod(0o700)
os.environ['PATH'] = str(bin_dir) + os.pathsep + os.environ['PATH']
os.execvpe(sys.argv[1], sys.argv[1:], os.environ)
